label: Gold

tricks.name: Bounce
tricks.what: Hops in place a few times.

tricks.name: Peekaboo
tricks.what: Drops out of sight, then pops back up.

tricks.name: Zoomies
tricks.what: Races back and forth along the taskbar.

tricks.name: Nap anywhere
tricks.what: Curls up wherever it is and sleeps for a bit.

tricks.name: Sit
tricks.what: Sits down for a while and looks around.

tricks.name: Lie down
tricks.what: Lies down on its side and dozes.

tricks.name: Spin
tricks.what: Turns all the way around, twice.

tricks.name: Wave
tricks.what: Waves hello when you arrive, and whenever you ask.

tricks.name: Dab
tricks.what: Drops a dab. Head down, arm out.

tricks.name: Flex
tricks.what: Both arms up. Holds it.

tricks.name: Moonwalk
tricks.what: Slides backwards along the taskbar, facing the wrong way.

tricks.name: Rot
tricks.what: Lies face down for a while and refuses to get up. A click gets it up, grumbling.

tricks.name: Spin out
tricks.what: Spins faster and faster, gets dizzy, staggers, flops.

tricks.name: Faint
tricks.what: A dramatic collapse. Recovers on its own and insists it's fine.

tricks.name: Side-eye
tricks.what: Turns away and gives you a look. Says nothing helpful.

tricks.name: Backflip
tricks.what: A jump with a full turn in the air and a squash on landing.

tricks.name: Sneak
tricks.what: Tiptoes along, crouched, looking around. Shh.

tricks.name: Panic
tricks.what: Runs back and forth screaming about nothing.

tricks.name: Meditate
tricks.what: Sits, closes its eyes, and floats a little. Ohm.

tricks.name: Loaf
tricks.what: Tucks everything in and becomes a loaf for a while.

tricks.name: Wiggle
tricks.what: A quick side-to-side wiggle.

tricks.name: Take a bow
tricks.what: A deep bow. Thank you, thank you.

tricks.name: Rock out
tricks.what: Air guitar and headbanging.

tricks.name: Stare
tricks.what: Stares at you. Does not blink. For a while.

tricks.name: Jumpscare
tricks.what: Turns into a folder, waits, then jumps out at you. Boo.

tricks.name: Yoga
tricks.what: Stretch, sit, lie down, breathe. Namaste.

tricks.name: Shiver
tricks.what: Shakes like it's freezing. Brr.

tricks.name: Sneeze
tricks.what: A big wind-up and an achoo that moves it a step.

tricks.name: Karate
tricks.what: Chops and lunges. Hi-ya.

tricks.name: Robot
tricks.what: Stiff quarter turns and beeps.

tricks.name: Hype
tricks.what: Arms up, bouncing, let's go.

tricks.name: Slow clap
tricks.what: A slow clap. Wow.

tricks.name: Blow a kiss
tricks.what: Mwah.

tricks.name: Parkour
tricks.what: Hops along the taskbar and back like it's a rooftop.

tricks.name: Chase the cursor
tricks.what: Runs after your cursor for a few seconds.

tricks.name: Snack
tricks.what: A quick crunch of something.

tricks.name: Homework
tricks.what: Opens the laptop, sighs, nods off, wakes up.

tricks.name: Scream
tricks.what: Full volume, no reason.

tricks.name: Statue
tricks.what: Freezes mid-pose for a while. Do not touch the art.

behaviours.name: Clingy
behaviours.what: Drifts toward your mouse. Misses you faster.

behaviours.name: Show-off
behaviours.what: Does tricks on its own, more often.

together.name: Study with me
together.what: Sits down with a laptop and a book and keeps you company. Click it when you're done.

together.name: Work with me
together.what: Sits down with a laptop and a mug and keeps you company. Click it when you're done.

together.name: Game with me
together.what: Headphones on, controller out, plays alongside you. Click it when you're done.

together.name: Eat with me
together.what: Brings a bowl and eats when you eat. Click it when you're done.

name: Rocco
bio: Rocco is the troublemaker. It steals your cursor and gives you a look while you type. It's pretty sure it's famous.

nudge: Play with me. It's an order.
